units.source_text: 紫儿裹着源氏公子的衣服睡着。

en.t: Zi'er fell asleep wrapped in Prince Genji's robe.

units.source_text: 公子硬把她唤醒，对她说道：“你不要那样地讨厌我。

en.t: The prince forced her awake and said to her, "Do not dislike me so much.

units.source_text: 我倘是个浮薄少年，哪能这样地关怀你呢？

en.t: If I were a frivolous young man, how could I care for you like this?

units.source_text: 女儿家最可贵的是心地柔顺。”

en.t: What is most precious in a young girl is a gentle and obedient heart."
He had already begun to educate and guide her.

units.source_text: 紫儿的容貌，就近仔细端详起来，比远看时更加清丽可爱。

en.t: When Zi'er's face was studied carefully up close, it seemed even more pure and lovely than when seen from afar.

units.source_text: 源氏公子和她亲切地谈话，叫人到东殿去拿许多美丽的图画和玩具来给她看，

en.t: Prince Genji spoke warmly with her and sent someone to the eastern wing to bring many beautiful pictures and toys for her to see,

units.source_text: 又做她所喜爱的种种游戏。

en.t: and he also played all sorts of games that she liked.

units.source_text: 紫儿心中渐渐高兴，好容易起来了。

en.t: Zi'er gradually grew happier in her heart and at last managed to get up.

units.source_text: 她身上穿着家常的深灰色丧服，无心无思地憨笑，

en.t: She was wearing an ordinary dark gray mourning robe and smiled innocently, without a care or thought,
and her bearing was extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，自己也不知不觉地跟着微笑了。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw her, he too found himself smiling without realizing it.

units.source_text: 源氏公子到东殿去一下，这期间紫儿走出帘前，隔帘观赏庭中的花木池塘。

en.t: While Prince Genji went briefly to the eastern wing, Zi'er came out before the curtain and looked through it at the flowers, trees, and pond in the garden.

units.source_text: 但见经霜变色了的草木花卉，像图画一样美丽，

en.t: She saw grasses, trees, and flowers changed in color by frost, beautiful as a painting,

units.source_text: 以前不曾见过的四位、五位的官员，

en.t: and officials of the fourth and fifth ranks, whom she had never seen before,

units.source_text: 穿着紫袍、红袍在花木之间不绝地来来往往，

en.t: wearing purple and crimson robes, moving constantly back and forth among the flowering trees,

units.source_text: 她觉得这地方确实有趣。

en.t: and she felt that this place was truly fascinating.

units.source_text: 还有室内屏风上的图画，也都很有意思。

en.t: The pictures on the screens inside the room were also all very interesting.

units.source_text: 她看了很高兴，忘记了一切忧愁。

en.t: Looking at them made her very happy, and she forgot all her sorrow.
